scripts.predev: powershell -Command "3000,8000 | ForEach-Object { $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { Stop-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host \"Porta $_ libertada\" } }"
scripts.prestart: powershell -Command "3000,8000 | ForEach-Object { $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { Stop-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host \"Porta $_ libertada\" } }"
scripts.apresentacao: npm run build && npm run start
